headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: SAI (4)

summary: Max Verstappen won the United States Grand Prix Sprint from pole position, 3.9s ahead of Carlos Sainz, with Lando Norris completing the podium.
Oscar Piastri made the biggest climb, from P16 to P10.
Fernando Alonso had a day to forget, dropping from P14 to P18.
The stewards penalised PIA (5 second time penalty).
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 54 points over Lando Norris.
